It IS the contrast machinery's per-arm marginal — `finite_manifest::arm_marginal_interval` over the same `cell_posterior_draws` the pairwise estimator consumes (the AC-2 marginal-equality leg asserts interval+doubling equality against `finite_manifest_contrast`'s cells). All-planned bound `[s/M,(s+u)/M]` rides beside via `population::arm_bounds`.

## AC map → `crates/hh-eval/tests/r6_19.rs` (9 tests)

- AC-1/AC-5 `estimand_by_hand_and_unresolved` — θ_h/Δ recomputed by hand; one unresolved slot → `UnresolvedCell` on the involving contrast + all-planned bound + completion envelope (16,15,0,1) + labelled conditional secondary; the unaffected contrast computes.
- AC-2 `rate_marginal_equality_and_known_answer` — observed/posterior means by hand; interval+doubling **equal the contrast machinery's per-arm marginal** over `finite_manifest_contrast`'s cells; prior/level/bounds refusals; gate legs. `flips_and_solve_known_answers` — constant-p rerun known answer; **exact binomial enumeration** of the unbiasedness and swap−rerun identities; $/solve = 300µ$ known answer; 0-solve → `EstimatorUndefined`. `swap_and_excess` — swap 620k, rerun (400k,500k), excess 170k by hand; unpaired-task refusal.
- AC-3 `family_holm_bh_and_unavailable` — P2-FP-shaped two-member Holm family; exploratory BH pair; unavailable member retained at worst mass (`adjusted 1_000_000`); record/spelling/metric/population/gate refusals.
- AC-4 `tied_with_leader_route` — leader selection, tied row, the selection-caveat label; `equivalence`/`tost`/`no_difference`/`statistically_tied` claims refuse.
- AC-6 `results_schema_validates_and_mutations_fail` — complete fixture validates; 16 member-drop mutations fail; typed absent members (`refused` delta, `estimator_undefined` per_solve) admissible.
- AC-7 `task_mixture_slot_schedule_randomization` + `every_new_piece_refuses_gated_use` — the new spelling computes with its record (spelling carried in the report), refuses without it and on a broken digest, refuses gated use until GATE-G23 PASSED (and computes with the record); `lane_randomization` unchanged; every new piece shares the same gate.
